title: Completeness and residue calculation of a completed perfect coefficient model
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I\subset A$ be a maximal ideal, and put $k=A/I$. On $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\underline{A/I^n}$, using constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of finite projective $A$-modules, zero outside degrees $[a,b]$, and let $M^\bullet=B\otimes_A P^\bullet$ denote termwise extension of the constant complex; perfect complexes are [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Work in the module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $M^\bullet$ is locally derived $IB$-complete [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. Its derived residue reduction [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] has the canonical isomorphism $M^\bullet\otimes^L_B\underline k\simeq\underline{P^\bullet\otimes_A k}$. For every integer $q$, its cohomology is the constant sheaf of the finite-dimensional $k$-vector space $H^q(P^\bullet\otimes_A k)$, and both $M^\bullet$ and its residue reduction have zero cohomology outside $[a,b]$. The same assertions hold on every covering slice, with the restricted coefficient sheaf. No finiteness of the set $k$, no regularity of $A$, and no perfectness of $A/I^n$ over $A$ is required.
